item.title: False threat rumors rattle Vacaville schools
item.description: Fear and confusion spread rapidly among Vacaville families Thursday after two unrelated incidents at Willis Jepson Middle School were conflated online, sparking false rumors of potential violence at both Jepson and Vacaville High Schools. Vacaville Unified School District officials and the Vacaville Police Department said investigations found no credible or substantiated threats at either campus.
